```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Set Environment and load packages
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

rm(list=ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

if("pacman" %in% installed.packages() == FALSE) {install.packages("pacman")}
pacman::p_load(psych,
               ggplot2,
               tidyverse,
               magrittr,
               gmodels,
               foreign,
               ggcorrplot,
               Hmisc,
               DT,
               afex,
               lsmeans,
               rstatix,
               effectsize,
               cocor,
               sjPlot,
               sjmisc,
               reghelper,
               jtools,
               lavaan,
               plyr,
               ggdark,
               overlapping,
               corrr,
               pwr)

setwd("C:/Users/wilso/OneDrive - Umich/disease concealment/study 5 - healthy vs. sick/")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in data
# --------------------------------------------------------------------

# Load in data from study 4
load("./intermediate/DC healthy vs. sick (study 5) cleaned and recoded.rda")

# Filter out problems. Note that we want to only filter out problem = 1 because problem = N/A for condition "not sick"
merged_df %<>% filter(problem == 0 | is.na(problem))

# center predictors
merged_df$harm_final_c = c(scale(merged_df$harm_final, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
merged_df$centrality_c = c(scale(merged_df$centrality, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
merged_df$salience_c = c(scale(merged_df$salience, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
merged_df$cur_stigma_c = c(scale(merged_df$cur_stigma, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))
merged_df$concern_co_c = c(scale(merged_df$concern_co, center=TRUE, scale=TRUE))

# Sick df
sick_df <- filter(merged_df, condition == "sick")

# Not sick df
notsick_df <- filter(merged_df, condition == "notsick")
```

```{r descriptives}
psych::describeBy(select(merged_df, trans_risk, severity_final, harm_final, centrality, salience, cur_stigma, conceal_co, concern_co), merged_df$condition)
```

```{r multiple regression}
# Main effects of harm, condition, and interaction
conceal_lm <- lm(conceal_co ~ harm_final_c * condition, data = merged_df)
summary(conceal_lm)

simple_slopes(conceal_lm)

# for manuscript
ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = harm_final, y = conceal_co, fill = condition)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = condition), alpha = .25) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("Healthy", "Sick"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288")) +
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Healthy", "Sick"), values = c("#88CCEE", "#332288")) +
  labs(title = "Concealment likelihood by illness harm  and illness status",
       y = "Concealment Likelihood",
       x = "Illness Harm",
       fill = "Participant Illness Status",
       color = "Participant Illness Status") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black", size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "Black" , size = 12, hjust = .5))
```

```{r covid concern covariate}
# Same results even adding in COVID concern covariate
concealCOVcon_lm <- lm(conceal_co ~ harm_final_c * condition + concern_co_c, data = merged_df)

summary(concealCOVcon_lm)

simple_slopes(concealCOVcon_lm)
```

```{r csi covariates}
concealCSI_lm <- lm(conceal_co ~ harm_final_c * condition + centrality_c + salience_c + cur_stigma_c,
                    data = merged_df)

summary(concealCSI_lm)

summ(concealCSI_lm)

plot_model(concealCSI_lm, type = "int")

# Stigma and illness status
CSI_lm <- lm(conceal_co ~ cur_stigma_c * condition, data = merged_df)
CSI_lm <- lm(conceal_co ~ salience_c * condition, data = merged_df)
CSI_lm <- lm(conceal_co ~ centrality_c * condition, data = merged_df)

summary(CSI_lm)

summ(CSI_lm)

plot_model(CSI_lm, type = "int")
```
